responseMessageContents.description: This update addresses several issues to ensure the app is ready for users. We fixed a problem that was preventing new users from signing up, improved the video player to prevent crashes, and made the app feel smoother by showing saved content immediately while loading new information in the background. We also added extra safeguards to make the registration process more reliable and are performing final checks on the email system and web servers before the official release.
